name: normalizedKloosterman3
docstring_first_sentence: The rank-three Kloosterman sum over `ZMod p`, normalized by `1 / p`.

name: unnormalizedKloosterman2
docstring_first_sentence: The unnormalized classical Kloosterman sum `∑ u ≠ 0, ψ(u + c / u)` over the prime field, indexed by its units.

name: weightedEmpirical
docstring_first_sentence: The finite atomic measure assigning weight `max (x i) 0` to each sample `x i`.

name: finitePoissonLaw
docstring_first_sentence: The pushforward obtained by drawing a Poisson count of mean `μ.mass`, drawing locations from `μ.normalize`, and forming their weighted empirical measure.

name: cappedDyadicIntensity
docstring_first_sentence: The finite measure with density `1 / u` on `(0, ζ] ∩ (2^k, 2^(k+1)]`.

name: finiteFragments
docstring_first_sentence: Sum a doubly infinite family of fragment measures when the resulting measure has finite mass; return the zero measure otherwise.

name: fragmentLaw
docstring_first_sentence: For positive `ζ`, the probability law of the finite weighted fragment measure.

name: OuterBoundRow
docstring_first_sentence: An outer-table row `(scale, rootBound, faceBound, budget)`.

name: InnerBoundRow
docstring_first_sentence: An inner-table row `(massBound, budget)`.

name: outerOrderTwoBounds
docstring_first_sentence: The 17 exact integer rows for the order-two outer-component bounds and their rounded budgets.

name: outerOrderFiveHalvesBounds
docstring_first_sentence: The 35 exact integer rows for the order-`5 / 2` outer-component bounds and their rounded budgets.

name: innerBaseOrderTwoBounds
docstring_first_sentence: The seven exact rows for order-two inner components of the base region, recording integral bounds and rounded weighted budgets.

name: innerBaseOrderFiveHalvesBounds
docstring_first_sentence: The ten exact rows for order-`5 / 2` inner components of the base region, recording integral bounds and rounded weighted budgets.

name: innerEnlargedOrderTwoBounds
docstring_first_sentence: The eleven exact rows for order-two inner components of the enlarged region, recording integral bounds and rounded weighted budgets.

name: innerEnlargedOrderFiveHalvesBounds
docstring_first_sentence: The seventeen exact rows for order-`5 / 2` inner components of the enlarged region, recording integral bounds and rounded weighted budgets.

name: trialAngularSignature
docstring_first_sentence: The eleven multisets of exponents specifying the angular power-sum monomials in the trial function.

name: trialCoefficientInteger
docstring_first_sentence: The integer coefficient table for the eleven degree-at-most-six radial polynomials.

name: trialRadialPolynomial
docstring_first_sentence: The radial polynomial attached to angular signature `s`, with seven coefficients taken from the exact integer table and scaled by `10⁻¹⁰`.

name: angularMonomial
docstring_first_sentence: The product of power sums `∏ e ∈ σ, ∑ i, t i ^ e`, retaining multiplicities in `σ`.

name: trialMesh
docstring_first_sentence: The rational mesh width `(2742997 / 2624989) / 98304` used to discretize fragment masses.

name: trialLargestCap
docstring_first_sentence: The largest allowed fragment location, equal to `68225` mesh widths.

name: trialPhysicalMeasure
docstring_first_sentence: The physical fragment measure at the largest cap, obtained by scaling the fragment probability law by `exp(γ)` times that cap.

name: trialCellIndex
docstring_first_sentence: The natural-number floor of a fragment measure's total mass divided by the mesh width.

name: trialCellMidpoint
docstring_first_sentence: The rational midpoint `(j + 1 / 2) * trialMesh` of mesh cell `j`.

name: trialProfile
docstring_first_sentence: The two-pole rational profile with weights `21 / 200` and `179 / 200`, used multiplicatively in the trial function.

name: trialProfileValue
docstring_first_sentence: The exact rational trial-profile value at the midpoint of mesh cell `j`.

name: trialOuterMask
docstring_first_sentence: The indicator of the admissible 40-coordinate outer region: the summed cell index is at most `98263`, and every fragment measure obeys the radial band's location cap.

name: trialBaseMask
docstring_first_sentence: The indicator of the base 39-coordinate region, with summed cell index at most `89524` and the corresponding piecewise fragment-location cap.

name: trialEnlargedMask
docstring_first_sentence: The indicator of the enlarged 39-coordinate region, with summed cell index at most `89914` and its piecewise fragment-location cap.

name: trialFullMask
docstring_first_sentence: The indicator of the full 39-coordinate region: summed cell index at most `98263` and no fragment mass above the largest cap.

name: trialCore
docstring_first_sentence: The masked trial expression: a product of one-variable profiles times eleven radial-polynomial/angular-monomial terms.

name: trialPhysicalNormalizer
docstring_first_sentence: The fortieth power of the mesh-weighted one-dimensional squared-profile sum, used to normalize all trial integrals.

name: trialIH
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized squared `L²` integral of the 40-coordinate step trial function under the product physical measure.

name: trialJ0
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized sum of squared coordinate marginals integrated over the base 39-coordinate region.

name: trialJPlus
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized sum of squared coordinate marginals on the enlarged region outside the base region.

name: trialJTail
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized sum of squared coordinate marginals on the full region outside the enlarged region.

name: trialJLambdaH
docstring_first_sentence: The signed trial marginal functional combining the base, enlargement, and tail contributions with the specified exact rational coefficients.

name: PhysicalSourceRowData
docstring_first_sentence: Exact rational geometry for one source row: its order, radial band, activation level, outer and inner core radii, and their thresholds.

name: physicalSourceRho
docstring_first_sentence: The fixed rational density parameter `262499 / 1000000` used in source-row geometry.

name: physicalSourceOuterRadius
docstring_first_sentence: The outer radial cutoff, equal to `98304` mesh widths.

name: physicalSourceInnerRadius
docstring_first_sentence: The inner radial cutoff for the base (`ν = 0`) or enlarged (`ν = 1`) source family.

name: physicalSourceAdvance
docstring_first_sentence: The positive radial advance `10⁻⁷ / physicalSourceRho` separating source thresholds from the cutoff radii.

name: physicalSourceOrder
docstring_first_sentence: Assign source rows to orders one, two, and three using the index bands below `12`, from `12` to `23`, and from `24` onward.

name: physicalSourceAffine
docstring_first_sentence: The rational intercept and slope governing the source-row activation inequality, selected by source family and row order.

name: physicalSourceOmegaPrefix
docstring_first_sentence: The recursively advanced rational source parameter, starting at zero and capped at the family-specific terminal value.

name: physicalSourceRow
docstring_first_sentence: Construct the exact row geometry from two successive source parameters.

name: PhysicalSourceGroupData
docstring_first_sentence: In both TeX documents, `cap` is the group cap `z_G` and `split` is `p_G`.

name: physicalSourceGroup
docstring_first_sentence: The six covering groups: two outer groups, two base inner groups, and two enlarged inner groups, each pair having orders `2` and `5 / 2`.

name: physicalSourceRows
docstring_first_sentence: The finite set of source-family and row-index pairs assigned to covering group `g`.

name: physicalSourceLowBoundaries
docstring_first_sentence: The exact rational endpoints partitioning the low-fragment part of group `g`, from its activation level to its splitting point.

name: physicalSourceRankFractions
docstring_first_sentence: The rational subdivision fractions used to partition the rank component interval between its lower endpoint and the group cap.

name: physicalSourceLowCount
docstring_first_sentence: The number of consecutive low-fragment intervals, one less than the boundary-list length.

name: physicalSourceRankCount
docstring_first_sentence: The number of consecutive rank intervals, one less than the subdivision-fraction list length.

name: physicalSourceRowCount
docstring_first_sentence: The total number of covering components: all low intervals, all rank intervals, and one triple-count component.

name: physicalSourceComponentKind
docstring_first_sentence: Encode a component as `0` for low-fragment, `1` for rank, or `2` for triple-count.

name: physicalSourceComponentEndpoints
docstring_first_sentence: The rational endpoints of the chosen component: consecutive low boundaries, affinely rescaled rank fractions, or the split-to-cap interval for the triple-count component.

name: physicalSourceTheta
docstring_first_sentence: The exponential tilt for a low-fragment component, rounded upward from `7 / upperEndpoint` or `9 / upperEndpoint`, with the specified exceptional value `120`.

name: physicalSourceLowClipping
docstring_first_sentence: The lower radial clipping level obtained from eligible source rows activated below `u`, including rows absorbed from the preceding group where prescribed.

name: physicalSourceAlignedCapIndex
docstring_first_sentence: The fragment-cap index aligned with radial cell sum `r`, using the outer, base-inner, or enlarged-inner piecewise schedule according to the group.

name: physicalSourceRadialMask
docstring_first_sentence: The indicator that a component exists and its radial cell sum satisfies the global cutoff and clipped group bounds.

name: physicalSourceCountMeasure
docstring_first_sentence: Sum the coordinate fragment measures on positive locations and divide their density by the location.

name: physicalSourceCover
docstring_first_sentence: The nonnegative covering weight for one physical component, subject to radial and fragment-cap masks.

name: physicalSourceFaceWeight
docstring_first_sentence: The absolute-coefficient envelope on a 39-coordinate face: `1` on the base region, the larger enlargement/tail coefficient magnitude on the enlarged region, and the tail coefficient magnitude elsewhere.

name: physicalSourceOuterRoot
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized outer-component integral of the squared trial function, summed over all 40 faces and weighted by the covering function and face-coefficient envelope.

name: physicalSourceOuterFace
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized outer-component integral of the squared face marginal, summed over all 40 faces with the covering function and face-coefficient envelope.

name: physicalSourceInnerMass
docstring_first_sentence: The normalized covering-weighted squared-marginal integral for an inner component, summed over coordinates.

name: admissibleTuple
docstring_first_sentence: The forty shifts of diameter 186 in Equation (1.3) of the main paper, used in the proof of Corollary 1.2.

name: primeGapLiminf
docstring_first_sentence: The extended-real liminf of consecutive prime gaps; `Nat.nth Nat.Prime 0 = 2`.

name: dhl_40_2
docstring_first_sentence: Theorem 1.1 of the main paper: every admissible integer 40-tuple has two-prime translates.

name: infinite_two_prime_translates_admissibleTuple
docstring_first_sentence: Supporting conclusion in the proof of Corollary 1.2 for the explicit admissible tuple.

name: primeGapLiminf_le_186
docstring_first_sentence: Corollary 1.2 of the main paper: the lower limit of consecutive prime gaps is at most 186.
